_comment: Shared query bank for Google Jobs ingestion (google-jobs-serpapi-ingest.py and google-jobs-apify-ingest.py both read this). Restructured 2026-07-24 from a flat 24-query list into 4 strategic buckets weighted to Eric's actual positioning: 5 YOE full-stack SWE, 2.5yr career break, currently 5mo into a prompt/agent engineering program. Each bucket has its own daily_budget (SerpApi picks that many least-recently-run queries PER BUCKET, not globally -- see pick_stale_queries_by_bucket() in google-jobs-serpapi-ingest.py) so AI Integration and Bridge & Solutions (Eric's strongest differentiated positioning) get proportionally more daily coverage than the narrower Re-Entry bucket. Bucket daily_budgets sum to SERPAPI_DAILY_QUERY_BUDGET (8, free tier). Apify's single daily slot (APIFY_DAILY_QUERY_BUDGET=1) draws only from ai_integration + bridge_solutions -- see google-jobs-apify-ingest.py -- since that's the scarcest/most expensive resource and those two buckets are the highest-priority. Paid-tier scaling: bump each bucket's daily_budget directly (see per-bucket comments below for the proposed paid-tier split) -- no other code change needed.

core_swe._comment: Safety-net bucket: broadest posting pool, fastest path to interviews, leverages the real 5 YOE production background. Paid tier: bump daily_budget to 6.

ai_integration._comment: Highest strategic alignment -- directly matches the current prompt/agent engineering program. Paid tier: bump daily_budget to 10.

bridge_solutions._comment: The sweet-spot niche for this exact combo: real production engineering credibility + fresh hands-on AI/agent skills. Paid tier: bump daily_budget to 8.

reentry_growth._comment: Real and relevant given the actual 2.5yr career break -- but a narrower posting pool (fewer companies explicitly advertise gap-friendly framing), hence the lower daily_budget. Paid tier: bump daily_budget to 4.

queries.query: return to work software engineer remote
